optimizedDescription.value: YAML schema contract for artifacts, DAG, validation, metadata extraction, workflow hooks, plugins, extends, and resolution.

optimizedContext.value:
# Schema Format

## Rules
- Top-level: required `kind` (`schema|schema-plugin`), `name`, `version`; schema requires `artifacts`; optional description/extends, validations, workflow, extraction. `schema-plugin`: no `artifacts|workflow|metadataExtraction|extends|compat`; may declare validation/rules-related merge fields. Extends merges root→leaf; path cycle → `SchemaValidationError`.
- IDs: artifacts `/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/`; hook/validation/rule/cleanup/cross-validation/extraction IDs `/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/`, 1–64. Hooks globally unique across workflow; others unique immediate array; workflow identity `step`, participant identity `as`.
- Artifact: `id`, required `scope: spec|change`, `output`; `optional` defaults false; optional template/instruction/requires/format/`hasTasks`/rules/cleanup/validations/extraction. `delta` spec-only; change delta rejected. Filename final literal glob segment/template.
- `artifactDag()` canonical cached `requires` graph: `roots`, `childrenOf`, `topologicalOrder`, `descendantsOf`; consumers use it, never rebuild. Requires acyclic; non-optional cannot depend on optional.
- `validations` selector XOR JSONPath `path`, plus `required` zero-match only, `count`, `contentMatches`, `children`; delta equivalents run normalized delta YAML AST and require `delta:true`.
- Cross-artifact: `id`, same-scope `participants` (`artifact`, `as`, selector, optional keySelector, key), `relation` `all-equal|subset|superset`, aliases, optional `ordering: ignore|strict`; compare extracted keys, not raw AST.
- `metadataExtraction`: field → entries `artifact` + extractor (selector/extract/capture/strip/groupBy/transform/fields); transform runtime registry. `dependsOn` capture label/href, normalize failure explicit.
- Workflow: valid lifecycle `step`, optional artifact `requires`, subset `requiresTaskCompletion` targeting `hasTasks:true`, pre/post hooks. External hook `id` + `external.type` + opaque `external.config`; unknown runner type rejected. Array order display/axis only.
- Resolve ref: `@scope/name` npm; `#workspace:name`; `#name`/bare default workspace; path direct. Missing returns null; caller throws `SchemaNotFoundError`. Zod validates before domain construction; unknown top-level ignored.
- `verify.md`: `### Requirement:` mirrors specs; scenarios WHEN/THEN; verify normally `requires: [spec]`.

## Constraints
- Kind/scope required; plugin field prohibitions enforced.
- Duplicate IDs, invalid IDs, unknown requires, cycles, invalid workflow steps/task references, invalid delta validation, duplicate workflow steps → `SchemaValidationError`.
- Scope defines spec layout/validation/change completeness; delta/selectors/application → core:delta-format.
